title: Button light

says: Tell Claude your goal in the chat

offers.label: Pick “Red LED 5 mm” for light
offers.effect: Saves “Red LED 5 mm” as the pick for the light need in this project. Uses 1 of your 3 “Red LED 5 mm” for the light. May note the choice in your history.

offers.label: Drop the light need
offers.effect: To drop this need, tell Claude: “drop the light need”.

says: requirements.json differs from what the picks give

offers.label: Write the parts list
offers.effect: Writes the parts list, requirements.json, from your picks. Parts you wrote there yourself stay.

offers.label: Build the board
offers.effect: Saves its files in this project. Runs no simulation and costs nothing.

notes: This page reads the project's files. It does not know whether the board is wired or flashed.
wiring: Put the board on the breadboard.
Run a jumper from D2 to the button.

now.says: 1 need has no part yet: light. Tell Claude a pick for each, or to set it aside.
